description: List direct-message conversations for connected accounts that support DMs (X and Bluesky today). Returns conversation_id + account_id needed to open or reply to a thread.

account.description: Connected account UUID or unambiguous platform name

before.description: Cursor from a previous response's next_before

fresh.description: Bypass warm cache and re-read the platform APIs. Entries younger than 90s are still served from cache.

range.description: Lookback window. Use custom with since/until.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.
